air_used: 5/18 (route is 200 ticks = 30 s against an 18 s tank; dies at tick 120 without capsules)
aha: Capsules are solid blocks until grabbed: the floor capsule holds up the pearls' road and the middle capsule props up a stone, so each must be taken only after both pearls have passed it.
deadlocks: Grabbing the floor capsule (9,3) before both pearls have crossed it opens a hole; a pearl pushed over it drops into the sealed pocket below.
Grabbing the middle capsule (13,5) while a pearl is still east of it drops its stone onto the lower road between that pearl and the gate.
Running out of air: the route needs at least one refill, and at human pace all three.
